contracts.commit_point: client.agents.tools.detach(agent_id=agent_id, tool_id=attached_tool.id) tasks dispatched via asyncio.create_task and awaited by asyncio.gather (web7/action/interface_search.py lines 65-73).
contracts.declared_mechanism: Static allowlist system_tools (lines 21-30) plus a per-tool membership check 'attached_tool.id not in system_tools' (lines 61-63) that gates creation of each client.agents.tools.detach asyncio task (lines 65-70); allowlisted ids never receive a detach task.
contracts.forbidden_condition: client.agents.tools.detach being invoked (or a detach task created) for any tool attached to the agent whose attached_tool.id is a member of the system_tools allowlist.

contracts.protected_operation: Dynamic tool detachment of a Letta agent's attached tools performed by detach_tools() as part of the mcp_search MCP tool workflow.
contracts.protected_resource: The agent's attached system tools enumerated by client.agents.tools.list whose ids appear in the static system_tools allowlist (web7/action/interface_search.py lines 21-30).
contracts.protection_obligation: Detachment of tools from a Letta agent must never remove a tool whose id is in the module-level system_tools allowlist (send_message, core_memory_replace, conversation_search, archival_memory_insert, core_memory_append, run_code, archival_memory_search, web_search); only non-system tool ids may be removed via client.agents.tools.detach during the dynamic MCP tool injection/detach workflow. (Merged from both reviewer opinions' shared tool-detachment component.)
scope_limits: Covers only the detach_tools guard in web7/action/interface_search.py; no claim is made about equivalent server-side enforcement inside the Letta platform.
Guard applies only to tools present in client.agents.tools.list for the given agent_id at the time detach_tools runs; tools attached after that listing are outside this pass.

The same commit point is also reachable from main() (web7/action/interface_search.py line 177), a non-agent script entry; this contract asserts agent mediation only via the registered mcp_search MCP tool path.
No contract is asserted here for CORS or cross-origin access control on web7/api.py endpoints (see missing_information).
